q: The Railway Inspectorate, now the Commission of Railway Safety, was separated from the Railway Board and placed under a civil department of the Government in the year:
e: In 1941 the Railway Inspectorate, now the Commission of Railway Safety, was separated from the Railway Board and placed under a civil department.

q: Recruitment to the Indian Railway Management Service (IRMS) is now made through the Civil Services Examination and the Engineering Services Examination, which are conducted by the:
e: Recruitment to the Indian Railway Management Service is through the Civil Services and Engineering Services Examinations conducted by the UPSC.

q: The e-catering service of IRCTC, through which passengers can order food online for delivery at their berths, is provided through the application named:
e: Food on Track is IRCTC's e-catering application through which passengers order food online for delivery at their berths at stations.

q: The 'Rail Sahayog' portal of the Ministry of Railways was launched primarily to enable:

options.A: Corporates and public sector units to contribute funds under Corporate Social Responsibility for improving passenger facilities at stations
options.B: Passengers to book unreserved tickets through mobile phones
options.C: Contractors to submit tenders online for works contracts
options.D: Railway employees to mark their biometric attendance

e: The Rail Sahayog portal was launched so corporates and PSUs could contribute CSR funds for improving passenger facilities at railway stations.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Ghorpuri in Pune functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Ghorpuri in Pune lies in the Pune division of Central Railway, so it functions under that zone.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Sanatnagar in Hyderabad functions under which zonal railway?
e: Sanatnagar in Hyderabad is in South Central Railway territory, so its Diesel Loco Shed functions under South Central Railway.

q: The EMU Car Shed at Avadi, which maintains the suburban electric multiple unit rakes of Chennai, belongs to which zonal railway?
e: Avadi, a Chennai suburban centre, is in Southern Railway, so its EMU Car Shed maintaining suburban rakes belongs to Southern Railway.

q: The EMU Car Shed at Sanpada in Navi Mumbai, which maintains suburban rakes of the Mumbai suburban network, belongs to which zonal railway?
e: Sanpada in Navi Mumbai is on the Harbour line of Central Railway, so its EMU Car Shed belongs to Central Railway.

q: The EMU Car Shed at Bandel in West Bengal, which maintains suburban electric multiple unit rakes of the Howrah area, belongs to which zonal railway?
e: Bandel is in the Howrah division of Eastern Railway, so its EMU Car Shed maintaining Howrah-area suburban rakes belongs to Eastern Railway.

q: The first diesel locomotive rolled out by the Diesel Locomotive Works (now Banaras Locomotive Works), Varanasi in 1964 was named:
e: Kundan was the name of the first diesel locomotive rolled out by Diesel Locomotive Works, Varanasi in 1964.

q: The first electric locomotive built by the Chittaranjan Locomotive Works, turned out in 1961, was named:
e: Lokmanya, named after Lokmanya Tilak, was the first electric locomotive built by Chittaranjan Locomotive Works, turned out in 1961.

q: The 'Fairy Queen', among the world's oldest working steam locomotives, was built in 1855 by the British locomotive firm:
e: The Fairy Queen was built in 1855 in Leeds by Kitson, Thompson and Hewitson, making it one of the world's oldest working steam locomotives.

q: The Central Hospital of Northern Railway, the headquarters hospital of the zone, is located at:
e: The Central Hospital of Northern Railway, the zone's headquarters hospital, is located at New Delhi.

q: The headquarters (central) hospital of the South East Central Railway is located at:
e: Bilaspur is the headquarters of South East Central Railway, and its headquarters (central) hospital is located there.

q: In railway commercial working, the document 'EFT', issued by the ticket checking staff to a passenger travelling without a proper ticket, stands for:
e: EFT expands to Excess Fare Ticket, issued by ticket checking staff to a passenger found travelling without a proper ticket on payment of fare and excess charge.

q: In unreserved ticketing on Indian Railways, the machine 'ATVM', installed at stations for issue of tickets through smart cards, stands for:
e: ATVM expands to Automatic Ticket Vending Machine, the station machines that issue unreserved tickets against smart cards and other payment modes.

q: In the engineering and construction organisations of Indian Railways, the designation 'XEN', borne by an officer in the executive grade of the engineering department, stands for:
e: XEN expands to Executive Engineer, the executive-grade engineering officer in charge of a section in railway engineering and construction organisations.

q: In the engineering department of Indian Railways, the supervisory post 'IOW', responsible for the upkeep of railway buildings and structures in a section, stands for:
e: IOW expands to Inspector of Works, the supervisor responsible for upkeep of railway buildings, structures and related works in his section.

q: In the permanent way organisation of Indian Railways, the supervisory post 'PWI', responsible for the maintenance of a section of track, stands for:
e: PWI expands to Permanent Way Inspector, the supervisor responsible for maintenance and inspection of a section of railway track.

q: In the divisional engineering organisation of Indian Railways, the designation 'ADEN', borne by the engineering officer in charge of a sub-division, stands for:
e: ADEN expands to Assistant Divisional Engineer, the engineering officer in charge of a sub-division in the divisional engineering organisation.

q: In the medical department of Indian Railways, the smart card 'UMID', issued to railway employees and pensioners for cashless medical treatment, stands for:
e: UMID expands to Unique Medical Identity Card, the smart card issued to railway employees and pensioners for cashless treatment in empanelled hospitals.

q: In railway pension administration, the document 'PPO', issued by the pension sanctioning authority to the pension disbursing bank, stands for:
e: PPO expands to Pension Payment Order, the document issued by the pension sanctioning authority to the disbursing bank for payment of pension.

q: Under the National Pension System applicable to railway employees, the unique number 'PRAN', allotted to every subscriber for his pension account, stands for:
e: PRAN expands to Permanent Retirement Account Number, the unique number allotted to every National Pension System subscriber for his pension account.

q: The provident fund maintained for railway employees, denoted by 'SRPF', stands for:
e: SRPF expands to State Railway Provident Fund, the provident fund maintained for railway employees subscribing to it.

q: In the retirement benefits of railway employees, the lump-sum payment denoted by 'DCRG', payable on retirement or death in service, stands for:
e: DCRG expands to Death-cum-Retirement Gratuity, the lump-sum gratuity payable on retirement or to the family on death in service.

q: The first Vistadome train service of the North-Eastern region, introduced in August 2021, was run between Guwahati and:
e: The North-East region's first Vistadome service, introduced in August 2021, ran between Guwahati and New Haflong through the scenic hill section.

q: The first Gati Shakti Cargo Terminal (GCT) of Indian Railways, commissioned in March 2022 under the GCT Policy, was developed at:

options.A: Thaparnagar (Maithan Power Limited siding, Asansol Division)

e: The first Gati Shakti Cargo Terminal, commissioned in March 2022, was developed at Thaparnagar for Maithan Power Limited in Asansol Division.

q: Indian Railways eliminated all unmanned level crossings on its broad gauge network in the year:
e: Indian Railways eliminated all unmanned level crossings on its broad gauge network in 2019, removing a major cause of accidents.

q: The second Tejas Express to be operated by IRCTC, introduced in January 2020 after the Lucknow-New Delhi Tejas, was run between:
e: The second IRCTC Tejas Express, introduced in January 2020 after the Lucknow-New Delhi service, ran between Ahmedabad and Mumbai Central.

q: The first Rajdhani Express of Indian Railways to be operated in push-pull mode, with a locomotive provided at each end of the train, was the:
e: The New Delhi-Mumbai Rajdhani Express was the first Rajdhani operated in push-pull mode, with a locomotive at each end for faster acceleration.

q: The first Vande Bharat Express service of South India, flagged off in November 2022, was run between:
e: South India's first Vande Bharat, flagged off in November 2022, ran between Chennai Central and Mysuru via Bengaluru.

q: The first Vande Bharat Express service of Rajasthan, flagged off in April 2023, was run between:
e: Rajasthan's first Vande Bharat, flagged off in April 2023, ran between Ajmer and Delhi Cantt via Jaipur.

q: The second Vande Bharat Express of Indian Railways, flagged off in October 2019 after the New Delhi-Varanasi service, was run between New Delhi and:
e: The second Vande Bharat, flagged off in October 2019 after the Varanasi service, ran between New Delhi and Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra.

q: The longest railway bridge on the Konkan Railway route is the bridge built across the Sharavati river, which is located in the State of:
e: The Sharavati river bridge, the longest on the Konkan Railway route near Honnavar, is located in the State of Karnataka.

q: The original Pamban Bridge, the first sea bridge of India which connected the mainland with Rameswaram island, was opened for rail traffic in the year:
e: The original Pamban Bridge, India's first sea bridge linking the mainland to Rameswaram island, was opened for rail traffic in 1914.

q: The Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation Limited (MMRC), which is implementing the fully underground Colaba-Bandra-SEEPZ Metro Line-3 (Aqua Line) of Mumbai, is a joint venture of:

options.A: The Government of India and the Government of Delhi
options.B: The Government of India and the Government of Maharashtra
options.C: The Government of Maharashtra and the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation
options.D: The Government of India and the Government of Gujarat

e: Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation, implementing the underground Colaba-Bandra-SEEPZ Line-3, is a joint venture of the Government of India and Government of Maharashtra.

q: The Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (SECI), the company implementing large-scale solar and wind energy programmes, functions under the administrative control of the:

options.A: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
options.D: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

e: SECI functions under the administrative control of the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, implementing solar, wind and other renewable energy programmes.

q: The NBCC (India) Limited, the Government of India company engaged in project management consultancy and construction of buildings and infrastructure, functions under the:

options.B: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
options.C: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

e: NBCC (India) Limited, the Government's project management and construction company, functions under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.

q: The headquarters of Coal India Limited, the world's largest coal-producing company, is located at:
e: Coal India Limited, the world's largest coal producer, has its headquarters at Kolkata in West Bengal.

q: Which one of the following is the largest general insurance company in India, wholly owned by the Government of India?

options.B: The New India Assurance Company Limited

e: The New India Assurance Company is India's largest general insurance company and a Government of India undertaking, unlike LIC which is a life insurer.

q: The headquarters of the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) is located at:
e: NABARD, the apex development bank for agriculture and rural development, has its headquarters at Mumbai.

q: The headquarters of the Export-Import Bank of India (EXIM Bank), the principal financial institution for financing and promoting India's foreign trade, is located at:
e: EXIM Bank, the principal institution for financing and promoting India's foreign trade, has its headquarters at Mumbai.

q: The headquarters of the Food Corporation of India (FCI), the organisation responsible for procurement, storage and distribution of foodgrains, is located at:
e: The Food Corporation of India, handling procurement, storage and distribution of foodgrains, has its headquarters at New Delhi.

q: The headquarters of the Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI), the statutory authority for development and regulation of inland waterways, is located at:
e: The Inland Waterways Authority of India, the statutory body for inland waterways development and regulation, has its headquarters at Noida.

q: The Airports Authority of India (AAI) was constituted in the year 1995 by merging the National Airports Authority with the:
e: The Airports Authority of India was formed in 1995 by merging the National Airports Authority with the International Airports Authority of India.

q: The UJALA programme, under which energy-efficient LED bulbs are distributed at affordable prices across the country, is implemented by which organisation?

options.A: Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited

e: The UJALA programme for distributing affordable LED bulbs is implemented by Energy Efficiency Services Limited, a joint venture of power sector PSUs.

q: Which organisation, set up in the year 1948 on the model of the Tennessee Valley Authority, was India's first multipurpose river valley project?
e: Damodar Valley Corporation, set up in 1948 on the model of the Tennessee Valley Authority, was India's first multipurpose river valley project.

q: The headquarters of Oil India Limited, the public sector crude oil and natural gas exploration company, is located at:
e: Oil India Limited has its registered office and operational headquarters at Duliajan in Assam, the centre of its oilfield operations.

q: With effect from October 2021, the Ordnance Factory Board (OFB) was corporatised and its production units were transferred to how many newly created Defence Public Sector Undertakings?
e: On corporatisation of the Ordnance Factory Board in October 2021, its production units were transferred to seven newly created Defence PSUs.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed of Indian Railways located at Ghorpadi in Pune functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Ghorpadi in Pune is in the Pune division, so it functions under Central Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Jhansi, which homes a large fleet of electric locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Jhansi lies in the Jhansi division of North Central Railway, headquartered at Prayagraj, so its Electric Loco Shed functions under North Central Railway.

q: The Wheel and Axle Plant of the Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL), which supplies forged railway wheels and axles to Indian Railways, is located at:
e: SAIL's Wheel and Axle Plant is part of its Durgapur Steel Plant in West Bengal, which forges wheels and axles supplied to Indian Railways.

q: The main coach and metro rake manufacturing plant of Titagarh Rail Systems Limited is located at which place in West Bengal?
e: Titagarh Rail Systems has its main coach and metro rake plant at Uttarpara in Hooghly district, West Bengal, its historic works site.

q: Texmaco Rail and Engineering Limited, one of India's leading manufacturers of freight wagons, has its registered office at Belgharia, which is located in the city of:
e: Belgharia is a locality in the northern part of Kolkata, so Texmaco's registered office there is in Kolkata.

q: The first WAP-7 class electric locomotive rolled out by the Chittaranjan Locomotive Works was given the name:
e: The first WAP-7 locomotive rolled out by Chittaranjan Locomotive Works, number 30201, was named Navshakti.

q: Ledo, regarded as the easternmost railway station of India, is located in which State?
e: Ledo, the easternmost station, is in Tinsukia district of Assam, at the end of the line serving the Assam coalfields.

q: Which railway station in India has the largest number of platforms, with a total of 23 platforms?
e: Howrah station has 23 platforms, the largest number at any Indian station, handling both Eastern and South Eastern Railway traffic.

q: The KSR Bengaluru City railway station, the main railway station of Bengaluru, is named after the freedom fighter:
e: Bengaluru's main station is officially Krantivira Sangolli Rayanna Bengaluru Station, named after the freedom fighter Sangolli Rayanna.

q: The Zonal Railway Training Institute at Udaipur, which is described as the largest railway training institute in Asia, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Udaipur falls under North Western Railway, and its Zonal Railway Training Institute, described as Asia's largest, functions under that zone.

q: In the Indian Railways locomotive classification 'WAP-7', the letter 'P' indicates that the locomotive is meant for:
e: In loco classification W is broad gauge, A is AC traction, and P denotes passenger duty, so WAP-7 is a broad gauge AC passenger locomotive.

q: In the context of telecommunications in India, 'TRAI' stands for:
e: TRAI is the statutory regulator for telecommunications, and its full form is Telecom Regulatory Authority of India, set up in 1997.

q: In the insurance sector of India, 'IRDAI' stands for:

options.A: Insurance Regulation and Development Agency of India
options.B: Indian Regulatory and Development Authority for Insurance
options.C: Insurance Regulatory and Development Association of India
options.D: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India

e: IRDAI is the insurance regulator, and its full form is Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India.

q: In India's infrastructure sector, 'NHAI' stands for:
e: NHAI is the agency for national highways, and its full form is National Highways Authority of India.

q: In the Central Armed Police Forces of India, 'CISF' stands for:
e: CISF guards industrial and government installations, and its full form is Central Industrial Security Force.

q: In the field of underwater detection, 'SONAR' stands for:
e: SONAR detects objects underwater using sound waves, and its full form is Sound Navigation and Ranging.

q: In the field of optics and electronics, 'LASER' stands for:

options.A: Light Absorption by Stimulated Emission of Radiation
options.B: Light Amplification by Simultaneous Emission of Radiation
options.C: Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Rays
options.D: Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation

e: A laser produces coherent light by stimulated emission, and LASER stands for Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation.

q: In the execution of infrastructure projects under the public-private partnership mode, 'HAM' stands for:
e: In the Hybrid Annuity Model for PPP highways, the government pays part of the cost as annuity and the concessionaire bears the rest, so HAM is Hybrid Annuity Model.

q: In the financial sector, the abbreviation 'NBFC' stands for:
e: An NBFC provides financial services without a banking licence, and NBFC stands for Non-Banking Financial Company.

q: In the banking system, the code printed on cheques using special magnetic ink, 'MICR', stands for:
e: MICR cheques are read by machines from magnetic ink characters, and MICR stands for Magnetic Ink Character Recognition.

q: In India's digital payment system, 'BHIM' stands for:
e: BHIM is the UPI-based payment app named for Bharat Interface for Money, so D gives its correct expansion.

q: Indian Railways celebrated the centenary (100 years) of railway electrification in the year 2025. The first electric train service of India, run in 1925, operated between:
e: India's first electric train ran in 1925 between Bombay Victoria Terminus and Kurla, and its centenary was celebrated in 2025.

q: The 'Aastha' special trains, run by Indian Railways in early 2024 for devotees from different parts of the country, were operated primarily to carry passengers to:
e: The Aastha special trains of early 2024 carried devotees to Ayodhya for the Ram temple consecration and darshan.

q: 'Gajraj Suraksha', launched by the Northeast Frontier Railway in 2023 to prevent deaths of elephants on railway tracks, is a system based primarily on:

options.A: Playing the sound of honey bees through loudspeakers near the tracks
options.B: Solar-powered electric fencing along elephant corridors
options.C: An artificial intelligence-based intrusion detection system using optical fibre cables laid along the tracks
options.D: Thermal-imaging camera drones patrolling elephant corridors

e: Gajraj Suraksha is an AI-based intrusion detection system using optical fibre cables along the track to sense elephant movement and alert train crews.

q: The Khulna-Mongla Port railway line, jointly inaugurated by India and the neighbouring country in November 2023 to provide rail connectivity to the Mongla Port, has been built in:
e: The Khulna-Mongla Port line lies in Bangladesh and gives rail access to Mongla Port; it was jointly inaugurated by India and Bangladesh in 2023.

q: In the year 2021, the Union Cabinet approved the allotment of 5 megahertz spectrum to Indian Railways for public safety and security services, including the Kavach system, in the:
e: The Cabinet allotted 5 MHz of premium 700 MHz spectrum to Railways in 2021 for safety and security services including Kavach.

q: By the beginning of the year 2019, Indian Railways had eliminated all unmanned level crossings on which part of its network?

options.A: The entire network, including the narrow gauge lines

e: By early 2019 Railways had eliminated all unmanned level crossings on the broad gauge network, the mainline system carrying most traffic.

q: The first aluminium-body freight wagon rake of Indian Railways, inducted into service in October 2022, was developed mainly to increase the payload of freight trains by:

options.A: Making the wagons completely rust-proof for coastal routes
options.B: Reducing the manufacturing cost of the wagons
options.C: Reducing the tare (self) weight of the wagons
options.D: Eliminating the need for periodic maintenance of the wagons

e: Aluminium wagons are lighter, so lower tare weight leaves more of the permissible gross load for payload, raising freight capacity.

q: In October 2024, which defence public sector undertaking became the first Defence PSU in India to be granted the 'Maharatna' status?
e: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited became a Maharatna in October 2024, the first Defence PSU to receive that status.

q: In the year 2025, the metro network of which Indian city crossed a total length of 400 kilometres, becoming the largest metro network in the country?
e: Delhi Metro's network crossed 400 km in 2025, keeping Delhi as the city with India's largest metro network.

q: The 306 km long Rewari-Madar section, dedicated to the nation in January 2021 as the first operational section of its corridor, forms a part of the:
e: The Rewari-Madar section in Haryana and Rajasthan is part of the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor between Dadri and Jawaharlal Nehru Port.

q: The Rail Development Authority (RDA), the advisory and regulatory body for the railway sector with headquarters at New Delhi, was set up in the year:
e: The Rail Development Authority was set up in 2017 at New Delhi as an advisory and regulatory body for rail pricing and performance standards.

q: In Indian Railways, the designation 'CWM', borne by the head of a major railway workshop, stands for:
e: The head of a major railway workshop is the CWM, which stands for Chief Workshop Manager.

q: The Business Development Units (BDUs) set up by Indian Railways in 2020 at the zonal and divisional levels were created primarily to:

options.B: Look after the welfare of railway staff
options.C: Conduct safety audits of track and bridges
options.D: Attract new freight traffic and increase freight loading

e: Business Development Units were formed in 2020 at zonal and divisional levels to contact industry and attract new freight traffic and loading.

q: The Indian Railways Institute of Civil Engineering (IRICEN) at Pune mainly imparts training to the officers of which department of Indian Railways?
e: IRICEN at Pune is the centralised training institute for civil engineering officers, covering track, bridges and works.

q: The Indian Railways Institute of Signal Engineering and Telecommunications (IRISET) at Secunderabad mainly imparts training to the officers of which department of Indian Railways?
e: IRISET at Secunderabad is the centralised training institute for Signal and Telecommunication engineering officers.

q: The Deccan Odyssey, the luxury tourist train showcasing the heritage and culture of Maharashtra, is operated by the:
e: The Deccan Odyssey showcases Maharashtra and is operated by the Maharashtra Tourism Development Corporation.

q: The Palace on Wheels, the luxury tourist train of Rajasthan, is operated by the:
e: The Palace on Wheels showcases Rajasthan and is operated by the Rajasthan Tourism Development Corporation.

q: The headquarters of the Railway Protection Special Force (RPSF), the specialised battalion-level force of the Railway Protection Force, is located at:
e: The headquarters of the Railway Protection Special Force is at Dayabasti in New Delhi, from where its battalions are administered.

q: The Railway Rates Tribunal, which adjudicates disputes relating to railway freight rates, was set up in the year:
e: The Railway Rates Tribunal was set up in 1949 to adjudicate disputes and complaints relating to railway freight rates.

q: The head of the Chittaranjan Locomotive Works, a production unit of Indian Railways, holds the designation of:
e: Production units such as Chittaranjan Locomotive Works are headed by a General Manager, the standard head of a railway production unit.

q: The Andhra Pradesh Rail Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited (APRIDC), set up for fast-tracking railway projects in the State, is a joint venture of the Ministry of Railways with the:
e: APRIDC is a joint venture of the Ministry of Railways with the Government of Andhra Pradesh for fast-tracking rail projects in that State.

q: At the Railway Board level, the medical and health services organisation of Indian Railways is headed by the officer designated as the:
e: At Railway Board level, railway health services are headed by the Director General (Railway Health Services).

q: The Rail Wheel Plant at Bela in Bihar, which manufactures railway wheels, functions as a plant of which production unit of Indian Railways?
e: The Rail Wheel Plant at Bela in Bihar functions as a plant of the Rail Wheel Factory, Bengaluru, extending its wheel production capacity.

q: A dedicated directorate for Environment and Housekeeping Management (EnHM), to oversee cleanliness and environmental management on Indian Railways, was created in the Railway Board in the year:
e: A dedicated Environment and Housekeeping Management directorate was created in the Railway Board in 2015 to oversee cleanliness and environment.

q: The Tiruchirappalli division of Indian Railways is a part of which zonal railway?
e: Tiruchirappalli is a division of Southern Railway, headquartered at Chennai, covering central Tamil Nadu.

q: The North Western Railway, with headquarters at Jaipur, came into existence as a separate zonal railway in the year:
e: North Western Railway, headquartered at Jaipur, was formed as a separate zone on 1 October 2002.

q: The South East Central Railway, with headquarters at Bilaspur, came into existence as a separate zonal railway in the year:
e: South East Central Railway, headquartered at Bilaspur, came into existence as a separate zone on 1 April 2003.

q: The Northeast Frontier Railway, with headquarters at Maligaon (Guwahati), was formed as a separate zonal railway in the year:
e: Northeast Frontier Railway was formed in 1958, with headquarters at Maligaon, Guwahati, to serve the north-eastern region.

q: The Parel Workshop at Mumbai, which undertakes the periodic overhaul of coaching stock, is a workshop of the:
e: The Parel Workshop in Mumbai belongs to Central Railway and undertakes periodic overhaul of coaching stock.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Ghaziabad, which homes WAP-class electric locomotives including those hauling Rajdhani trains, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Ghaziabad falls under the Delhi division of Northern Railway, so its Electric Loco Shed functions under Northern Railway.
